title: Work IQ: memory profile path in Work IQ MCP for agents
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, billing statements and documented control paths are supported. It distinguishes existing memory controls from the planned memory-profile path and appropriately leaves that path's default, specific permissions and governance details open.

1. Create or open the agent in Copilot Studio.
2. Select the Build tab.

claims.claim: Makers control whether an individual agent uses Memory.
claims.quote: Makers control whether an agent uses Memory.

claims.claim: Agent memories are deleted after 28 days of inactivity.
claims.quote: Memories are deleted after 28 days of inactivity.

claims.claim: The 28-day inactivity period starts from the last time the agent used a user's memories.
claims.quote: The period starts from the last time the agent used a user's memories.

claims.claim: Viewing memories in the portal does not reset the retention period.
claims.quote: Viewing memories in the portal doesn't reset the period.

claims.claim: Turning agent Memory off does not immediately delete stored memories.
claims.quote: Turning Memory off stops the agent from saving or using memories. It doesn't delete stored memories right away.

claims.claim: The Work IQ MCP policy page is reached in the Microsoft 365 admin center through Agents > Tools > Work IQ MCP > Policy.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation, select Agents > Tools.
In the tools registry, select Work IQ MCP.
On the Work IQ MCP details pane, select the Policy tab when it's available.

claims.claim: Work IQ MCP policy can be turned on or off at tenant scope.
claims.quote: In the Microsoft 365 admin center, tenant administrators can turn Work IQ MCP policy on or off for the tenant.

claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ MCP tenant policy settings API update Allowed Disallowed; "Work IQ" "policy" "PATCH". Opened MCP policy governance and read MCP reference search excerpts; policy concepts are described, but no operation for setting this switch was found.

claims.quote: Searched: "/memory/me/coreMemories"; "Work IQ" "coreMemories" memory permissions default. Opened Work IQ API overview and permissions reference; read MCP overview and tool reference excerpts. No page documenting the named path was returned.

claims.claim: Purview retention policies do not apply to Copilot memory.
claims.quote: Retention policies and retention labels configured in Purview by organization admins don't apply to Copilot memory.

claims.claim: Administrators cannot restrict what type of information is added to Copilot memory.
claims.quote: No, admins can't restrict what type of information is added to Copilot memory.

claims.claim: Saved memories are discoverable using eDiscovery and Microsoft Graph Explorer.
claims.quote: Saved memories and inferred memories from your chat history are discoverable using eDiscovery and Microsoft Graph Explorer.

claims.claim: Inferred chat-history memories are discoverable using eDiscovery and Microsoft Graph Explorer.
claims.quote: Saved memories and inferred memories from your chat history are discoverable using eDiscovery and Microsoft Graph Explorer.

claims.claim: Custom instructions are not discoverable through those administrator discovery tools.
claims.quote: Custom instructions aren't accessible, but can manually be exported by the user through Settings > Personalization.

claims.claim: Administrators can delete Copilot memory data through Microsoft Graph Explorer in combination with Purview.
claims.quote: An admin can also delete memory data through Microsoft Graph Explorer in combination with Purview.
